title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on How to Calculate the Time Limit for Review and Prosecution of Cases Where the Same Suspect Is Investigated for Both Duty Crimes and Other Crimes Successively

articles.content_en:
SPP Interpretation No. 2 [2022]
The People's Procuratorate of Jiangsu Province:
Your Request for Instructions on How to Calculate the Time Limit for Review and Prosecution in Interrelated Cases (Su Jian Fa San Bu Zi [2022] No. 2) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
For cases where the same criminal suspect is suspected of duty crimes and other crimes, and the supervisory authority and the investigative authority transfer the case to the People's Procuratorate for review and prosecution at different times, and where consolidated handling is necessary, the time limit for review and prosecution shall be recalculated from the date of acceptance of the later case.
This reply is given.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
November 15, 2022
